name: Clear reference sky

original_specification.name: Clear reference sky
original_specification.description: Clear reference sky is a conceptual setting for outdoor product review; facade review. It combines the specified surroundings with independently managed lighting.
original_specification.representation: Procedural HDR ambient illumination with neutral ground or an existing scene
original_specification.geometry: Sky dome and neutral ground without a mandatory landscape
original_specification.ambient_lighting: Procedural sky with exactly one explicit sun
original_specification.scale_policy: Distant sky with ground scaled to the subject; preserve subject dimensions; fit the stage once to an explicit selection, never continuously rescale the CAD model
controls: Solar azimuth and elevation or date and time
original_specification.authoring_method: Original procedural sky; optional volumetric cloud and atmosphere models; AI panoramas are declared LDR backplates only
validation: Check sun direction and energy; do not duplicate sky sun and directional light.
Compare at fixed exposure and keep weather separate from material wetness.

geometry_summary.units: millimetres Z-up in OBJ; metres Y-up in glTF/GLB

radiance.source_owner: HDR owns distant room/task patches; the separate Sun owns solar energy

background.limitations: Not a photograph or native renderer output; finite scene geometry is provided separately.

limitations: Sky/weather radiance is an artistic analytic field, not a calibrated atmosphere. Optional rain/snow/fog intent is retained separately.
Procedural family realization with named contextual components; no claim that every physical detail of the concept has been modeled or validated.
Native glTF import retains geometry and scalar appearances, not arbitrary material extensions or textures.
